{{Top|leg}}
'''Yellow Team''' was a unit of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives working in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]. They were involved in the [[Battle for Black Ice|capture]] of the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'', and were responsible for capturing an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] bunker.
